## What is Betting?

figure: vig-vs-odds / vig-dist / odds-dist

```{r fig-vig-vs-odds}
p1 <- odds |> 
    ggplot(
        aes(
            decimal_odds_fighter_1, 
            decimal_odds_fighter_2, 
            size = vig, 
            color = bookmaker)) +
    geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = bookmaker, data_id = source))

girafe(p1)
```
